title: Parameter-Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation for EEG-FM under Fixed Computational Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2608.24727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EEG foundation models pretrained via self-supervised learning promise transferable representations, but their generalization remains limited, especially across diverse clinical datasets. Full fine-tuning is impractical for resource-constrained clinical settings due to high computational requirements. In this work, we investigate whether parameter-efficient self-supervised adaptation, updating only 9% of parameters suffices to align representations to target tasks. We evaluate our method on two state-of-the-art models with different pretraining objectives: BIOT (contrastive) and CBraMod (masked reconstruction), and evaluate on three clinical EEG datasets for abnormality detection (TUAB), event classification (TUEV), and seizure detection (CHB-MIT) under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions. translated_title: 固定计算预算下基于参数高效自监督适配的脑电图基础模型
translated_abstract: 通过自监督学习预训练的脑电图基础模型承诺具有可迁移的表征，但其泛化能力仍然有限，尤其是在跨多样临床数据集时。由于计算需求高，全量微调在资源受限的临床环境中不切实际。在本工作中，我们探究了参数高效的自监督适配——仅更新9%的参数是否足以将表征对齐到目标任务。我们在两个具有不同预训练目标的最先进模型上评估了我们的方法：BIOT（对比学习）和CBraMod（掩码重建），并在三个临床脑电图数据集上进行了评估：异常检测（TUAB）、事件分类（TUEV）和癫痫发作检测（CHB-MIT），涵盖了分布内和分布外条件。自监督适配相比线性探测带来了持续的性能提升，AUCPR最高提升20倍。在固定计算预算下，峰值性能需要...
tldr: 本文证明在固定计算预算下，仅更新9%参数的自监督适配即可显著提升脑电图基础模型的泛化能力，相比线性探测在临床任务上最高提升20倍AUCPR。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that self-supervised adaptation with only 9% parameter updates can significantly improve EEG foundation model generalization under fixed computational budgets, achieving up to 20x AUCPR gains over linear probing on clinical tasks.
